input.quote: (e) THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
input.rationale: Section 5 warrants only legal compliance (knowledge-qualified), authority/rights and non-infringement, plus anti-bribery covenants; § 1(b) contains a bare professional and workmanlike performance covenant. Nowhere does Contractor warrant that deliverables/Works conform to the Specifications or documentation for any period, and there is no repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy. Because the disclaimer in § 5(e) then strips all implied warranties (merchantability, fitness), Company is left with no conformance protection for defective work — short of the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies) and close to an effective "as is" outcome. We inserted a new § 5(e) giving a 90-day conformance warranty with a real remedy and renumbered the disclaimer, which already preserves express warranties so no further carve-out is needed. No malicious-code warranty is noted but not separately flagged.

proposal.summary: Add a 90-day deliverable conformance warranty with re-performance/repair/replacement/refund remedy, and renumber the disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 5 contains no conformance warranty or remedy for defective work, so we added a 90-day warranty that Deliverables conform to their Specifications and documentation, backed by re-performance, repair, replacement or refund. This is our standard position; we can discuss a shorter cure window if the remedy is preserved.

ops.text: (e) Contractor represents and warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards, and that, for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each deliverable and Work will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and its documentation. Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Contractor's option, re-performance, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services, deliverable or Work, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, deliverable or Work.
